contract: Quality CI must not silently expand direct network capability in test sources actually executable in the canonical Quality workflow checkout.
baseline_identity: exact Git blob SHA per reviewed Quality-executed loopback source file
source_discovery: test-source paths are derived from .github/workflows/quality.yml; only references resolving to existing files in the current checkout are scanned, because quality.yml intentionally contains version-tolerant optional file references guarded by existence checks
latest_result: PASS: Quality Run #67 completed successfully on the exact PR head; CI test-source network client boundary and all subsequent Quality gates passed.
outside_baseline_blocked: socket import or direct socket calls
fail_closed: Quality workflow unreadable or contains no test references
Quality workflow resolves no existing test sources
reviewed baseline Git blob SHA drift
direct network-capable import or call outside reviewed baseline
diagnostics: absent version-tolerant workflow references are reported but not classified as executable sources
direct network findings include repository-relative file and source line
limitations: Source-level expansion guard only. Existing reviewed Quality security/startup tests intentionally use local loopback networking. This does not prove an OS-level egress sandbox and does not fully exclude indirect networking through imported application modules.
boundary: No product/UI/schema/domain behavior, no sudo, no new workflow permission, no secret, no OIDC, no dependency installation and no browser/device gate promotion.
